title: Turing-Complete Templating Configurations (Purely Conditional Tags)
damaged_code:
```html

Special Banner

 ```
pattern: The implementation of complex nested conditional tags and logic loops directly inside template configurations.
why_bad: Turns configuration and view templates into uncompiled programming languages. It introduces untestable branching pathways, breaks static type checking, and creates unmaintainable runtime logic.
detection: The use of nested `<IF>` or conditional formatting structures within configuration, markup, or YAML files.
fix: Treat conditional tags as code smells; compute conditional logic inside the compiled source code, passing only raw variables or simple boolean values to templates.
source: [The Addison-Wesley signature series] Martin Fowler - *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2015_2002, Addison-Wesley Professional).pdf, Chapter 12.
